summary: CVC-PE Global Private Equity Fund, LP filed an 8-K reporting the sale of unregistered limited partnership units in a continuous private offering, raising ~$31.9M across three classes at April 30, 2026 Transactional NAV. The offering relies on Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D exemptions and includes a feeder vehicle for tax-exempt/non-U.S. investors. This is a routine capital raise by an investment fund, not a special situation event. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation element is present. The filing is purely an operational update on unit sales and NAV disclosure.
